record.summary: Apart from the accepted Text size change, the render matches the reference: same header, Appearance card, Navigation card with its first four rows, and tab bar.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Text size: the control is disabled (muted labels) and its line under it says "Coming soon" in place of "Scales the whole app: Small 87.5 %, Default 100 %, Large 112.5 %." (step D adds text size later). On a narrow screen the one-line note makes every section below it sit about one text line higher.
accepted_deviations.note: The Small / Default / Large labels are muted and the note says "Coming soon". The old note was also one line at this width, so the Navigation card stays at the same y position (about 460 px) in both pictures.

accepted_deviations.as_given: A new "NOTIFICATIONS" section with one "Notifications" switch (off) sits between the Navigation section and the New chat defaults section. So New chat defaults sits lower, or below the bottom edge.
accepted_deviations.note: Both pictures end in the Navigation card at the Projects row, above the tab bar, so neither the Notifications section nor New chat defaults is in view.

accepted_deviations.as_given: The Notifications switch moved to that section: the desktop rail no longer has the "Notifications / Blocked in Settings" switch at its bottom, and the More drawer no longer has the "Notifications / Blocked in Settings" row at its end. So the drawer is shorter and its top edge sits lower.
accepted_deviations.note: This tablet frame shows a bottom tab bar, with no desktop rail and no open More drawer. The tab bar is the same in both pictures.

limits: The side-by-side image was shown scaled down, so I could not check differences under about 2 px. The pixel diff shows only antialiasing-level outlines outside the Text size row.
Content below the Projects row of the Navigation card is outside the viewport in both pictures.
